categories.main_business_segments: Zhengzhou Jiean Hi-Tech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in virtual simulation training systems, focusing on railway transportation, emergency safety, maritime vessels, and aviation sectors. The company provides comprehensive virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and mixed reality (MR) based training solutions for vocational education and professional skill development, especially in rail transit and emergency safety. It also has emerging markets in intelligent connected vehicles and aircraft maintenance training.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including VR, AR, MR, system simulation, distributed collaborative simulation, big data, and artificial intelligence. It has developed its proprietary JANVR engine platform and employs a modular, layered architecture for product development. Production involves a combination of self-developed software and outsourced hardware manufacturing, with a focus on digital twin, AI-assisted training, and intelligent evaluation systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national and regional railway groups (e.g., China State Railway Group), metro companies, vocational colleges offering rail transit and emergency safety programs, and enterprises in transportation and safety sectors. The company also serves aviation schools, maritime enterprises, and military academies. Its markets span vocational education, professional skill competitions, and enterprise training within transportation and safety industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, covering 31 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions. It also has an international presence serving clients in seven countries across three continents, including projects aligned with the Belt and Road Initiative in countries like South Africa, Thailand, Laos, and Pakistan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhengzhou Jiean Hi-Tech operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the development and delivery of virtual simulation training systems and solutions. It integrates software development, hardware assembly (outsourced), and service provision for end-user training applications, acting as a technology and solution provider rather than a raw material supplier or final consumer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment in AI, digital twin, and intelligent training platforms, aiming to upgrade products from functional to intelligent systems. It plans to develop a multi-modal vocational education large model integrating text, image, video, and audio understanding. Strategic priorities include expanding AI-enabled vocational training products, enhancing digital education ecosystems, and strengthening industry-academia collaboration to support national skill development policies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of virtual simulation training systems and related hardware, supplemented by technical service fees for system upgrades, new module development, and customized solutions. The company operates mainly on a project-based sales model, winning contracts through bidding processes, and provides after-sales technical support and training services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player and pioneer in China's rail transit virtual simulation training industry, holding a comprehensive product line covering all major rail transit specialties. It has established significant brand recognition and technical barriers through extensive patents and software copyrights. While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a technology innovator with a strong foothold in vocational education and transportation sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 383.88 million, a 7.84% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 54.93 million, up 9.12%. Total assets were about RMB 1.06 billion with a slight decrease from the previous year. The company maintains steady growth supported by increased orders in urban rail transit and aviation sectors, with R&D expenses accounting for over 10% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhengzhou Jiean Hi-Tech offers highly integrated, intelligent virtual simulation training solutions tailored to vocational education and industry needs, emphasizing realistic, multi-disciplinary, and collaborative training environments. Its proprietary JANVR platform and extensive patent portfolio enable cross-domain technology transfer and product diversification. The company differentiates itself by combining advanced VR/AR/MR technologies with AI-driven intelligent assessment, supporting national skill standards and large-scale vocational competitions, thereby enhancing training effectiveness and safety.
